### Stop Wrestling with God
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-mar-16-2010-11627421.html
Passage: Habakkuk 1:2
Points:
- Habakkuk wrestled with God over apparent divine silence amid widespread moral decline and injustice.
- Believers today often face similar confusion when crying out to heaven during painful circumstances.
- Spiritual testing and unanswered questions are normal experiences in the life of faith.
- Christians should move through their doubts by choosing to anchor their trust in God's character.

### How Long, Lord? Why?
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-september-13-2024.html
Passage: Habakkuk 1:2-3
Points:
- Habakkuk struggled with both God's timing and His apparent tolerance of sin among His people.
- Faithful believers today wrestle with the very same perplexity regarding moral decay in the church.
- God’s delays are purposeful, aligning with His sovereign timing to mature and protect His people.
- Scripture encourages believers to bring their honest questions, pain, and laments directly to the Lord.
